description: Allowed-input manifest whose input entry carries a valid reachable revision, but the declared sha256 does not match the file content at that revision. The immutable source binding MUST reject this with ALLOWED_INPUTS_HASH_MISMATCH; a hash that does not match the committed bytes at the claimed revision is a falsified binding.

allowed_inputs_record.description: A manifest whose input entry points to a real revision but declares a hash that does not match the file bytes at that revision. The revision is valid; the hash is forged.
